purpose: Make water aviation explicit on both sides: float reconnaissance, flying boats, water fighters, Zuiun fast-confirmation, seaplane tenders/base support, and shipborne spotting. Preserve the authoritative rule that water aviation is a mission system, not free aircraft totals.

japan_local_marshall.accounting_guard: All numbers below are subsets of the re-audited Marshall local aircraft total; they are not additive to 136/133.

legacy_952_Ebeye_Kwaj_float_recon.historical_anchor: USSBS 25-Jan disposition gives 952 AG 10 float reconnaissance at Kwajalein.

other_legacy_float_recon.distribution: Taroa/Jaluit/outer lagoon detachments; no invented full extra kokutai.

Zuiun.state: first-detachment system now mature enough for local use; subset of recon/attack slots
Zuiun.distribution_center: Ebeye/Kwaj 2; Taroa 1; Wotje 1; Jaluit 1; one flexible/maintenance slot

Kyofu.state: subset of local fighter/local-cover slots, not additional fighters
Kyofu.role: low/medium local interception, scout/torpedo-bomber denial, runway-suppression bridge; not a sustained F6F sweep fighter

japan_local_marshall.unique_water_air_serviceable_center: about 29 including Kyofu; 20 are reconnaissance/observation/Zuiun class and 9 are water fighters. Some mission categories overlap but individual aircraft are counted once.
japan_local_marshall.H8K_guard: No resident H8K squadron is credited in the Marshall local total on 2 Feb. Historical 25-Jan disposition puts the small 802 AG flying-boat element at Saipan; H8K may contribute long-range regional search only.

japan_regional_water_air.historical_anchor: 902 AG about 10 float reconnaissance on 25 Jan
japan_regional_water_air.effect: regional search/staging/repair; not direct local CAP over Kwajalein.

japan_regional_water_air.historical_anchor: 802 AG about 5 flying boats + 902 AG about 4 float reconnaissance
japan_regional_water_air.effect: very-long-range strategic search and communications; sortie rate to Marshall approaches is low and weather/fuel expensive.

japan_regional_water_air.branch: residual Kyofu local defense 4-8 serviceable working band after Oct damage/repair; not included in Marshall total and cannot directly defend Roi.

japan_regional_water_air.effect: seaplane anchorage/staging potential; no untraced resident combat aircraft created.

japan_survivability_rule: Runway cratering does not automatically suppress floatplanes/Kyofu/Zuiun operating from lagoon/anchorage.
US must separately damage ramps, cranes, tenders/support craft, fuel/ammunition points, radio and anchorages.
Sea state, recovery time, corrosion/maintenance and exposed anchorage cap sortie generation; do not turn surviving water into unlimited operations.

united_states_forward_water_air.historical_98_group_guard: The 98-aircraft search/patrol group includes both seaplanes (PBY/PBM) and land patrol aircraft (PB4Y/PV); do not call all 98 seaplanes.
support_ships: Curtiss AV-4: Commander Air Central Pacific flagship at Tarawa from 31 Dec 1943.
Mackinac AVP-13: tended aircraft at Tarawa through Jan, then moved to Makin with VP-72 for around-the-clock tending during Marshalls campaign.
united_states_forward_water_air.VP72_role: Distributed PBY detachments used Dumbo/rescue, sector work and January minelaying; rescue flights often coordinated with surface ships/submarines.
operational_effect: Dumbo aircrew recovery, reducing personnel attrition after aircraft loss
united_states_forward_water_air.not_a_strike_bonus: These aircraft do not become 16 extra dive/torpedo bombers against Taroa.

shipborne_floatplanes.US: Battleship/cruiser OS2U/other shipboard floatplanes are separate from the 365 Gilbert land-air count and mainly support gunfire spotting, local reconnaissance and rescue. They do not materially change the first TF58 airfield-suppression sortie count.
shipborne_floatplanes.Japan: No forward Japanese surface-fleet floatplane pool is credited to Marshall morning defense unless the parent cruiser/battleship is actually present. Chitose/Chiyoda are not teleported forward.

first_strike_implication: Water aviation makes the Japanese warning/search network harder to decapitate than runway-only accounting suggests, but the US Gilbert patrol/tender system simultaneously raises ASW/search persistence. Net effect is information persistence on both sides, not a flat aircraft-strength increase.
